description:
Because:

- connected-services lived in fxa-shared, not in an nx lib.

This commit:

- Moves packages/fxa-shared/connected-services to @fxa/accounts/connected-services.
- Moves every fxa-auth-server and fxa-admin-server importer and amplitude.ts.
- Ports the 4 mocha tests to jest and deletes the old folder and exports.
- Adds cldr-localenames-full 46.0.0 to the root package.json.
- Keeps the ScopeSet brand; fxa-shared/db still builds ScopeSet.

Closes FXA-10653
